channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Leon Black sues House committee over Epstein probe subpoena
item.description: Billionaire Leon Black filed a lawsuit against the House Oversight Committee after not appearing for a deposition.

item.title: U.S. official says Iranian attacks did not affect military facilities used by U.S.
item.description: After a warning from President Trump, Iran claimed new strikes against U.S. forces in Kuwait and the UAE.

item.title: Judge weighs extending block on Postal Service mail voting rules
item.description: A federal judge is deciding whether to keep blocking a USPS rule that adds new requirements for mail-in voting.

item.title: Iran live updates: Trump defends Lutnick, says no US deaths in Iran conflict
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains the key flashpoint in the ongoing conflict.
